level_thresholds.semantics: persistent experience compared to current level threshold

player_growth.max_attack: same gain as attack (technical interval repair)

evidence.locator: zhsh/src/monster.js Monster constructor and assault victory settlement
evidence.finding: The surviving source calculates experience as monster level multiplied by 2. This produces tens of thousands of low-level encounters against the imported cumulative level thresholds and is rejected as a formal compatibility rule.

The independent implementation reads exp_reward and money_reward_min/max from each monster record, proving rewards need not be derived from the level-times-2 formula. Exact populated values are not present in that repository.
Nearby level-appropriate monsters and instances close ordinary level gates in a reasonable number of encounters; thousands of encounters are abnormal.

encounter_rewards.derivation: A single continuous level gradient is fitted to the formal cumulative thresholds and task reward scale. Encounter-type multipliers follow the source monster-type difficulty ordering; no task, series, city, or level receives a special multiplier.
encounter_rewards.replacement_condition: Replace when an authoritative populated monster reward table or an unambiguous original reward formula is recovered and validated jointly against the original level thresholds and task rewards.

task_rewards.semantics: each task prize experience value is settled through Task.completeTask -> Play.addPrize

failure_recovery.formal_rule: zhsh defeat returns with 1 HP; church prayer restores full health for zero fee

training_modifiers.pet: optional active pet adds damage and status effects
training_modifiers.team: social/persistence implementation; no Monster.assault integration found
training_modifiers.ship: sailing capability; no ordinary ground Monster.assault integration found
training_modifiers.planner_policy: close the current prefix without assuming an unobtained pet, team, crew or ship

reasonable_training.derivation: The earliest source dungeon requires 40 victories within a source-configured 50-minute session; planner uses combat rounds, deterministic win sampling, cache capacity and refresh delay instead of a fixed fight count.

adjudication_overlay.decision: retain accepted level*40 compatibility gradient only for the already accepted playable baseline until authoritative populated original rewards are recovered; do not use it for higher-level expansion
adjudication_overlay.source_fact: zhsh executes level*2; astrbot expects per-monster exp_reward but its database is unpopulated; dpcq is MOD drop-table experience

adjudication_overlay.decision: increase max attack with base attack to prevent the attack interval from inverting after repeated level-ups
adjudication_overlay.source_fact: zhsh levelUp increments attack but omits maxAttack

adjudication_overlay.decision: apply the source Play.addCopper zero lower bound to formal sailing repair charges
adjudication_overlay.source_fact: zhsh Sailing shipDamage calls Play.addCopper(-repairCost), whose implementation clamps copper at zero

adjudication_overlay.decision: ordinary location encounters are renewable through the five-minute cache; formal runtime may expose immediate replay but planner budgets source cache capacity and refresh delay
equipment and an active pet can widen survivable training, but current closure must not assume either unless actually obtained; team and ship do not enter ordinary assault settlement
record linear exp_max, per-monster exp_reward, pet assist and 5% death loss as an alternative implementation, not original numeric authority
record dp_levels and drop-driven experience only as MOD auxiliary evidence
